data.gender_notes: Ahearn is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Ahearn is derived from the Old English words 'a' (noble) and 'hearn' (warrior). It signifies a noble warrior, an exalted fighter in Christian contexts. The name Ahearn carries the meaning “Exalted warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ahearn usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who carry the spiritual strength of a warrior.
data.etymology: Ahearn belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ahearn total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: אהרן
in_hebrew.meaning: אוריגינל שם פירושו ' אחיו של אהרון'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אהרן הוא שורשיו באהרון אחיו של משה, שהיה הכוהן הראשון של עם ישראל. השם עצמו מורכב משתי מילים: 'אח' ו-'רן', שפירושו 'אור' או 'רוח'. לכן, השם אהרן מתפרש כ'אחיו של האור' או 'רוחו של אח'. השם אהרן הוא שם חשוב בתורה ובמסורת היהודית, והוא גם שם נפוץ בקרב הנוצרים.

in_greek.name: Αχέρνης
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αχέρνης ή Αχάρνης προέρχεται από το εβραϊκό όνομα אהרן (Aharon), που σημαίνει 'αδελφός του φωτός' ή 'αυτός που φέρνει φως'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Aharon αναφέρεται στον Aaron, τον αδελφό του Μωυσή και τον πρώτο ιερέα του λαού Ισραήλ. Το όνομα Αχέρνης έχει χρησιμοποιηθεί ως επώνυμο και ως όνομα στην Εκκλησία Ορθόδοξη.

in_latin.name: Ahearn
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Ahearn originem ducit ex hebraico nomine אהרן (Aharon), quod significat 'frater lucis' vel 'illustris'. In Scriptura Sacra, Aaron fuit frater Moysis et primus sacerdos populi Israel. Nomen Ahearn in traditione christiana usitatum est, praesertim in familia catholica.

in_english.name: Ahearn
in_english.long_meaning: The surname Ahearn is of Irish and Hebrew origin. It is derived from the Hebrew name אהרן (Aharon), meaning 'brother of light' or 'noble'. In the Bible, Aaron was the brother of Moses and the first high priest of the Israelites. The name Ahearn has been used in Christian tradition, particularly in Catholic families, and is associated with qualities of leadership, spirituality, and illumination.
